notes: 48 layers: 36 Gated DeltaNet (linear attention) interleaved 3:1 with 12 gated full-attention layers, MoE 512 experts / 10 active. Constant recurrent state (~36 MB bf16) plus KV only on the 12 attention layers = 24,576 B/token (~3.0 GiB at 128k). Native 262,144 context. No benchmark table captured yet - needs a scoring pass before it can rank. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card publishes no benchmark table and the record carries no rows - nothing to verify, not an omission. Card has no benchmark table; only install and sampling guidance. INGESTED 2026-10-22: five benchmark rows recovered by reading the vendor charts directly - the card carries benchmarks only as PNG images (benchmarks.png, swebench_pro.png), which is why a text-only pass reported zero benchmarks. Values are vendor-published and read by eye from a bar chart, so treat them as +/-0.5; the two charts agree where they overlap (SWE-Bench Pro 44.3 vs 44).
